#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

class IntStack {
    vector<int> array;
public:
    IntStack() { array.reserve(8); }
    void push(int item) {
        array.push_back(item);
    }
    int size() const {
        return array.size();
    }
    int get(int i) const {
        assert(i < size());
        return array[i];
    }
    void resize() {
        // vector handles resize automatically
    }
    string toString() const {
        string s = "[";
        for(size_t i = 0; i < array.size(); ++i) {
            s += to_string(array[i]);
            if(i != array.size() -1) s += ", ";
        }
        s += "]";
        return s;
    }
};

class NumberTheory {
public:
    class Modulus {
        IntStack factorial;
        IntStack invFactorial;
    public:
        virtual long long modulus() const = 0;
        Modulus() {
            factorial.push(1);
            invFactorial.push(1);
        }
        long long fact(int n) {
            while(factorial.size() <= n) {
                long long lastFact = factorial.get(factorial.size() - 1);
                factorial.push((int) mult(lastFact, factorial.size()));
            }
            return factorial.get(n);
        }
        long long fInv(int n) {
            int lastKnown = invFactorial.size() -1;
            if(lastKnown < n) {
                vector<long long> fInv(n - lastKnown);
                fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for(int i=1; i<fInv.size(); ++i) {
                    fInv[i]=mult(fInv[i-1], n - i + 1);
                }
                for(int i=fInv.size() -1; i>=0; --i) {
                    invFactorial.push((int)fInv[i]);
                }
            }
            return invFactorial.get(n);
        }
        long long ncr(int n, int r) {
            assert(n >=0);
            if(r<0 || n<r) return 0;
            return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
        }
        long long smallInv(int n) {
            return mult(fInv(n), fact(n-1));
        }
        long long normalize(long long x) const {
            long long m = modulus();
            x %= m;
            if(x<0) x+=m;
            return x;
        }
        long long add(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long v= a + b;
            long long m= modulus();
            return v < m ? v : v - m;
        }
        long long subtract(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long v= a - b;
            long long m= modulus();
            return v<0? v + m : v;
        }
        long long mult(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long m= modulus();
            return (a * b) % m;
        }
        long long mult(const vector<long long>& x) const {
            long long r=1;
            for(auto i: x) {
                r=mult(r,i);
            }
            return r;
        }
        long long inv(long long value) const {
            long long g=modulus(), x=0, y=1;
            for(long long r= value; r != 0; ) {
                long long q= g/r;
                g %= r;

                long long temp= g;
                g= r;
                r= temp;

                x -= q*y;

                temp= x;
                x= y;
                y= temp;
            }
            assert(g==1);
            assert(y==modulus() || y== -modulus());
            return normalize(x);
        }
    };

    class Mod998 : public Modulus {
    public:
        long long modulus() const override {
            return 998244353LL;
        }
    };

    static long long modPow(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
        long long result=1LL;
        long long curr=base%mod;
        while(exp>0) {
            if(exp &1) result= (result * curr)%mod;
            curr= (curr* curr)%mod;
            exp>>=1;
        }
        return result;
    }
};

struct HZSShufflesCards {
    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;
    int n,m;
    void solve() {
        cin>>n>>m;
        mod.fInv(n+m);
        long long phaseSize=1;
        long long p=1;
        for(int i=0; p!=0; ++i) {
            p=mod.mult(p, n - i, mod.inv(n + m - i));
            phaseSize= mod.add(phaseSize, p);
        }
        long long answer=0;
        for(int k=1; k<=n; ++k) {
            long long term= mod.mult(
                mod.ncr(n, k),
                m + k,
                mod.inv(k),
                phaseSize
            );
            if(k%2==1) {
                answer= mod.add(answer, term);
            } else {
                answer= mod.subtract(answer, term);
            }
        }
        cout<<answer<<endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    HZSShufflesCards solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
